purpose: fixed event-study comparison; not parameter optimization or portfolio performance

panel.label: 科创50
panel.group: A股成长，已见过同指数样本

selection_policy: fixed named panel chosen by underlying-index/asset coverage before signal-return computation; currently listed funds, so survivorship bias remains

split_labels.historical_holdout: on/after 2021-01-01; retrospective validation, not genuinely untouched OOS

unseen_future_validation: new data after 2026-11-13, not available yet
entry: next trading session open after signal close
exit: close of holding session h, counting entry session as 1
cost_scope: scenario assumptions, not claimed current broker quotes; round-trip combines commission/spread/slippage
execution_limits: daily opens/closes are theoretical fills; no intraday liquidity/limit queue/lot size model
dedup: per symbol and rule and horizon retain first event; skip new events with entry<=previous retained exit; do not force different rules to share signals
purge: development event entry and exit both before split; holdout signal+entry+exit on/after split; drop horizon-truncated events
benchmark: same ETF and same date segment unconditional forward return using all eligible next-open-to-h-close opportunities; equal-weight ETF aggregation, no pooled-events-only headline
mae: minimum intraday low equity along holding path, not close-only drawdown
multiple_comparisons: report all rules, horizons and costs; no best-only selection; primary outcome B_plus versus B at h10/cost10
inference: report paired episode comparisons and date-block bootstrap for dependence; exploratory, no confirmed edge claim
data_audit: store input hashes, sources, date coverage, adjustment/corporate-action assumptions, invalid rows and cross-source mismatches. No silently remap corporate action dates by best price fit.
